behavior: With `multiple`, `Select.Root` and `Combobox.Root` read `null` in `modelValue` as an empty array, and the part stays controlled. The default slot of `Select.Value` and `Combobox.Value` gets an empty array. The `validate` function of `Field.Root` gets an empty array, and a field that has no selected item again is not dirty. ArrowLeft at the start of `Combobox.Input` in `Combobox.Chips` gives no error. Without `multiple`, `null` stays a value, because an item can have the value `null`. Vue accepts `null` for an optional prop with no warning, so a `v-model` whose ref becomes `null` gives `null` to the part. Base UI gives the `null` to the function child of `Select.Value` and `Combobox.Value` and to the validation of the field. A field of Base UI that has no selected item again stays dirty, and `Combobox.Input` throws a `TypeError` for ArrowLeft in `Combobox.Chips`.
